changes.before: On August 26, 2025 the Board amended the interim ordinance to lift the pause in specified manufacturing and industrial districts while retaining it in other districts. On November 4, 2025 the Board adopted permanent BESS zoning regulations. The interim ordinance had been scheduled to expire January 23, 2026 unless repealed earlier; its exact termination and the permanent ordinance effective date require verification.
changes.after: The August 26, 2025 amendment partially lifted interim BESS restrictions in specified manufacturing and industrial districts. Signed Ordinance 2025-1864, adopted November 4 by 5–0, expressly repeals the remaining amended interim ordinance in its entirety (section XVI). Its signed adoption page records December 5, 2025 as effective and operative; section XVII separately says 30 days after adoption. The normalized endpoint follows the explicit county-stated date, without recomputing that clause or asserting later current force.
